title: The extension unit telescope of a complex is colimiting
statement: For every cochain complex C of integral coefficient modules on X, its scalar sequence has a colimit cocone whose vertex is isomorphic to termwise restricted scalar extension of C, and whose zeroth leg under that isomorphism is the termwise extension adjunction unit. Definitions and notation: [def-weil-pbc-integral-localization-telescope].

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), referring to Bhatt–Scholze Lemma 6.8.2; scalar localization telescope

proof.text: Construct the scalar unit cocone for the adjunction on complexes, using componentwise invertibility of ℓ on extended modules. Evaluation at each degree identifies its zeroth leg with the module extension unit. All other legs agree by leg determination. The module telescope is colimiting, and evaluation jointly reflects colimits of complexes. The scalar-invertibility transport uses the single public mappedScalar_isIso helper from the module telescope module. Scalar invertibility reuses the existing module_nsmul_isIso or derived_nsmul_isIso theorem from ContinuousConstructibleIntegralImage, made public without changing its type or proof.

theorem integralComplexLocalization_colimit (X : Scheme.{u})
    (C : CochainComplex (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) ℤ) :
    ∃ c : Cocone (integralLocalizationSequence ℓ C), Nonempty (IsColimit c) ∧
      ∃ e : c.pt ≅ ((Mod.comap (D := Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
            (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          (((Mod.extendScalars
            (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C),
        c.ι.app 0 ≫ e.hom =
          ((Mod.extendRestrictAdjunction
            (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap ℓ E) X)).mapHomologicalComplex
            (.up ℤ)).unit.app C
